description: No two rugs are alike, each one is unique and special just for you. Made by hand from strips of recycled fabrics then lining them up repeatedly to create a beautiful, one of a kind rug. Be sure to place rug grip under rug to keep in place and act as a barrier between the floor and the rug, as this is a hand dyed product and colors may bleed. DII rag rugs are rich in a variety of colors are just dark enough to hide stains in between washing. DII rag rugs are the perfect rug for any shabby chic, up-cycled, or rustic style home. No two rugs are the same, so get one for your love ones, friends, and family.

Protect your flooring in high traffic areas with these beautiful rag rugs. The colors are bright and fun adding a pop of color to your home. These nice rag rugs are a perfect way to complete the shabby chic look. No need to make your own rag rug, DII makes them for you!
COMES IN ALL SHAPES AND SIZES

Seven different sizes including two round rugs options and over 10 colors to choose from, we have the perfect rag rug for you. Need a runner for a hallway? Round area rug for a small sitting room or apartment? A rug for a laundry or mud room to dry off the bottom of shoes? A mat for the kitchen or under pet dishes? These rugs can be used for many different purposes and last a long time. Easy to clean and reversible for an extended life these rugs will add a vibrant color boost to any room
Rugs contain a mix of recycled fabric and are made to withstand any conditions and are double sided for even longer life. Spot clean when needed.
